author: Shreyas Gupta
changes: Renamed from SG_NDPMS_TEMP1 to Ionic_Portfolio_Review; old name retired, not aliased.
Self-update: check_version.py compares this copy against the delivery branch and can replace itself.
Repo-root walk fixed - it required a folder literally named 'NIFTY 500', so a clean clone joined ZERO universe rows and every signal dot rendered hollow on a deck that built with exit 0.
New gate check_dots.py: reads the built .pptx and asserts the five-signal dots carry colour. No other gate can see an empty universe join.

client_intake.py was matching against portfolio_quant.csv (59 rows, ONE client's book) instead of the 751-name universe, and its ISIN lookup was always empty so every equity fell through to banned name-prefix matching.
New 05_DATA_OFFICE/data/isin_master.csv - 2,404 NSE equities, the only exact join key from a client CAS to the scored universe. Joins 750 of 751 scored symbols.
Stripped UTF-8 BOMs from 11 tracked files; three other SKILL.md files had silently broken frontmatter as a result.
Corrected the claim that the scores are not in the repo - they are, and acting on the old text means redoing finished work.
notes: sequence is the field compared for staleness; version is for humans.
